question: Which of the following is a tertiary consumer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Snake.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A** tertiary consumer** is an organism that feeds on **secondary consumers.**
 
• In this case, the **snake** feeds on **frogs** or other small animals that** feed on insects or plants.**
 
• **Grass** is a **primary producer **and forms the base of the **food chain.**
 
• It is eaten by **primary consumers** such as** grasshoppers.**
 
• A **frog** is a **secondary consumer** as it feeds on insects such as **grasshoppers **or other small animals that feed on plants.
 
• Grasshopper is also a **primary consumer** that feeds on grass or other plants.
 
• Understanding the** trophic levels in a food chain** is important for understanding the **flow of energy and nutrients** in an ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Grass **is an important food source for many herbivores such as** cows, sheep, and deer.**
 
• **Snakes** are **carnivorous** and feed on a variety of prey such as **rodents, birds, and other small animals.**
 
 
• They play an important role in controlling the population of their **prey and maintaining the balance **in the ecosystem.
 
 
 
• **Frogs** are **amphibians** that are found in many different habitats such as **ponds, lakes, and streams.**
 
 
• They are important predators of insects and other small animals and are also an important food source for many larger predators such as **birds and snakes.**
 
 
 
• **Grasshoppers** are **herbivorous insects** that feed on a variety of plants such as **grass, leaves, and flowers.**
 
 
• They are an important food source for many animals such as **birds, rodents, and reptiles.**
